packageRules.description: One Python version everywhere: the image, .python-version and every requires-python move in one PR, merged by hand after `uv lock`.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `uv lock` with the mise uv and push it (Renovate does not relock after a regex bump), and check that every dependency ships wheels for the new Python.

packageRules.description: pep621 also reads requires-python (python-version datasource); the regex manager below owns that line.

customManagers.description: Bump the requires-python floor of every pyproject with the Python image.
